intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“科学家长期研究 -> 前往 Lake Kivu -> 靠近喷发扎营 -> 设法拍照但不能久留 -> 岩浆逼近 -> 及时逃脱 -> 返回火山口测温 -> 贡献观察”的故事线跟读。重点读清 active volcanoes、was able to、managed to、could not、liquid rock、just in time 和 so that 的目的关系。

sentences.text: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：波兰科学家 Tazieff 一生研究世界各地的活火山和很深的洞穴。注意插入语 the Polish scientist 读轻一点，has spent his lifetime 是长期投入。

sentences.text: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一九四八年，他去刚果的 Lake Kivu 观察一座后来命名为 Kituro 的新火山。地点短语要稳，which 引导的补充说明不要读散。

sentences.text: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：火山猛烈喷发时，他仍然能够在离火山很近的地方扎营。was able to 读出具体做到，while 后面读出危险背景。

sentences.text: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：虽然他设法拍到精彩照片，但不能在火山附近久留。Though 先让步，managed to 表示困难中成功，could not 标出限制。

sentences.text: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他发现一股液态岩石正向他流来。a river of liquid rock 要作为一个画面读出来，coming towards him 读出逼近感。

sentences.text: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：它几乎要完全包围他，但 Tazieff 设法及时逃脱。threatened to surround 读出危险，just in time 不要吞掉。

sentences.text: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：这一次，他设法爬进 Kituro 的火山口，以便拍照和测温。managed to climb 读出困难，so that 后说明目的。

sentences.text: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他能告诉我们比任何在世的人都更多的活火山知识。has been able to 是长期结果，than any man alive 读出最终评价。
